What I actually do

You do not need to name the problem. If you recognise yourself here, I can help.

🔌

Your website no longer loads

Blank page, error message, site not found. I track down where it comes from and bring it back online. Often the same day.

🔒

Your website has been hacked

I clean it up, close the way in, and explain how it happened so that it does not happen again.

🔑

Your provider has vanished

I recover the credentials, the domain name and the hosting, then take over your website. You own your tools again.

📂

You cannot get your files back

Server, storage space, mailbox full. I go and fetch them, and I show you how to do it next time.

💾

Nobody knows whether your backups exist

I check what is backed up and what is not, put in place what is missing, and tell you what to keep an eye on.

⏱️

A task eats your time every week

Copying data across, renaming files, sending the same documents. I check whether it can run on its own. Often, it can.

Tell me your problem →

Not sure which box you fall into? Write to me anyway, I will tell you.

How it works

Three steps, no nasty surprises

No jargon, no opaque quote, no dependency created on purpose.

1

You explain it in your own words

Just describe what you see. You have nothing to prepare, and there is no such thing as a silly question.

2

I look, then I quote the price

What is going on, what it costs, how long it takes. You decide afterwards, knowing exactly where you stand.

3

I fix it, and I show you

I explain what changed and what to watch out for. My goal is not to have you call me every week.

🎓 Certified trainer (ECP Formation): I share knowledge, I do not make myself indispensable.

About

Matthieu Viel,
your IT person in Réunion Island

I have been building websites and applications since September 2008, and I have lived in Saint-Pierre since 2018. I work with business owners who have no technical background as much as with technical teams who need a senior opinion. In both cases the rule is the same: I explain what I am doing.

On the technical side, 18 years of web development (Symfony, React, PHP, API Platform), on high-traffic platforms (Citeo, Sellermania) as well as business applications and my own projects. My approach: understand first, propose second, and never make myself indispensable.

Frequently asked

What people ask before calling

I know nothing about IT, is that a problem?

No, that is the most common case. You describe what you see, I handle the rest and explain it without jargon.

How much does it cost?

I look first, then I quote the price, and you decide before I start. Never the other way round.

Do you travel on site?

On site in the south of Réunion Island, and remotely everywhere else in France.

Do you only work on websites?

No. Mailboxes, files on a server, backups, access credentials, everyday tools: anything that blocks your business.

Someone else built my website, can you still help?

Yes, including when you no longer have the credentials. Getting you back in control of your own tools is part of the job.

How quickly do you reply?

Within 24 hours by email. For an emergency such as a site that is offline or hacked, call +262 693 85 28 12 directly.
